text: sed -n '20,40p' src/codegen_support/runtime/io/builtin_filter_id.rs: am_apply_filter_chain` hands the id to /// `__rt_apply_stream_filter`, a byte-transform helper. `zlib.*`, `bzip2.*` and /// `convert.iconv.*` are not entries here and must not be added as such — they /// are per-call-site attach sequences that install a per-fd handle and a /// program-local helper thunk (`_zlib_fwrite_fn` and friends), which no /// run-time name lookup can reconstruct. Naming them here would mint a node /// carrying an id the chain then hands to a byte transform that does not exist /// for deflate: the attach would report success and filter nothing. /// /// `string.strip_tags` is absent for the opposite reason: php has no such /// filter since 8.0, so it must miss and warn. pub(crate) const BUILTIN_FILTER_NAMES: &[(&str, u8)] = &[ ("string.toupper", 1), ("string.tolower", 2), ("string.rot13", 3), ("dechunk", 5), ("convert.base64-encode", 6), ("convert.base64-decode", 7),
